subject: ACME POC  access provisioning, success criteria, and evaluation plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME POC kickoff - access provisioning, success criteria, and next steps
Attachments: redwood-poc-mop.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Jenna / Liam -

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed plan to get the POC running this week so your engineers can start validation: 

Summary / success criteria (as agreed)
- Accuracy: Redwood LLM responses must meet a precision baseline on your question-answer eval set (target: >= 88% on the seed set).
- Latency: 95th percentile < 400ms for 256-token prompt on our dedicated trial instance.
- Cost/throughput: sustain 4 qps with KV cache; nightly batch eval not to exceed projected cost targets we discussed.

Evaluation plan
- Week 0 (this week): access provisioning + test dataset ingest; baseline run on seed eval set.
- Week 1: run automated evals + live traffic ramp (non-prod) with monitoring dashboards shared.
- Week 2: success criteria review and decision point.

Ownership
- ACME technical owner: Jenna Park (you) - validation & test data
- Redwood POC owner: Marissa Cole - access, config, run cadence
- Redwood SE: Neha Kapoor - SSO/API setup, troubleshooting

Immediate asks / next steps (what we need from ACME)
1) SSO: please invite SAML SSO for neha@redwood.com and marissa@redwood.com (we'll provide SP metadata below).
2) IP allowlist: please allow the following Redwood egress IPs for the trial cluster: 34.201.12.50/32, 34.201.12.51/32 (temporary) - confirm if you need CIDR format only.
3) Procurement: if you need the MSA + SOW signed before we provision, loop in procurement; otherwise we can provision trial access under the NDA.
4) Test API keys: once SSO/allowlist are done we'll issue a scoped trial API key and a short-lived dashboard invite.

Attached is our POC Method of Procedure (redwood-poc-mop.pdf) with step-by-step provisioning tasks and the eval checklist.

I'll follow up with the SAML SP metadata and an initial test API key once I get confirmation on the allowlist and SSO invites.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME POC kickoff - access provisioning, success criteria, and next steps

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap - this aligns with what we discussed. A couple of quick items from our side: 

- Confirming ACME technical owner is me; I'll coordinate the test data and run the eval scripts.
- Procurement: attaching our standard NDA (acme-signed-non-disclosure.pdf). We can sign the MSA if needed but prefer to start the trial under the NDA and then finalize commercial terms after the POC.
- SSO: we use Okta. Can you provide the SP metadata (ACS URL, Entity ID) and the recommended attributes (email, name, groups)?
- IP allowlist: we will need the exact IPs/CIDR for our firewall team; prefer them as a comma-separated list.

If folks from Redwood can provision a scoped API key and a dashboard invite once procurement confirms, that would let our eng team start tomorrow.

Hi Jenna -

Thanks - below are the SP details and a temporary test API key stub to help your firewall/infra team validate connectivity. Neha (cc'd) will create the SSO configuration on our side and can accept your Okta assertion once you invite neha@redwood.com as an IdP user.

SP / SSO details (for Okta configuration)
- SP Entity ID: urn:redwood:sp:poc:acme
- ACS URL: https://sso.redwood.com/saml/acs
- NameID format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
- Attributes: email, givenName, familyName, groups
- SP metadata URL (public): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-poc-metadata/acme-sp-metadata.xml

Temporary trial API key (scoped, read/write to test env): redwood-test-AB12CD34 (rotate on first use)
Redwood egress IPs for allowlist: 34.201.12.50/32, 34.201.12.51/32

Next steps from Redwood
- Neha will send an Okta invite to your Okta admin email (please confirm recipient) and we will accept the SSO assertion once your team configures the SP.
- Once SSO + IP allowlist confirmed, we'll provision the dashboard and the API key above and share the monitoring link.
- We'll run the baseline seed eval and share results in the dashboard within 24 hours of provisioning.

If procurement needs the MSA signed first, let me know and I can escalate to Contracts - otherwise we can proceed under the NDA attachment you shared.

Thanks - looping Neha for the technical handoff.

-
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
